inputs.resume_text:
KABIR MALHOTRA
PGP 2025-27 | Indian Institute of Management Calcutta | kabirm2027@email.iimcal.ac.in

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS
PGP, IIM Calcutta, 2025-27, CGPA 8.2/10 (Top 10% of batch)
B.Com (Hons), Shri Ram College of Commerce, 2025, 9.1/10 (Rank 3)
CAT 2024: 99.86 percentile

SUMMER INTERNSHIP
Bain & Company, New Delhi | Summer Associate | Apr - Jun 2026
- Market-entry assessment for a Japanese two-wheeler EV maker in India: sized the electric scooter market across 40 cities and built a city-prioritisation model on charging density and ownership cost
- Interviewed 35 dealers and 12 fleet operators; findings shifted the client's launch city list from Delhi NCR first to Pune and Bengaluru first
- Received Pre-Placement Offer (PPO)

CORPORATE INTERNSHIP
Kotak Mahindra Bank | Strategy Intern | May - Jul 2024
- Benchmarked 6 private banks' credit card rewards programs and recommended cutting 2 low-use reward categories

CASE COMPETITIONS
- National Winner, HUL L.I.M.E. Season 16 (2026): rural distribution of a premium detergent; 1 of 3 winners from 21,000 teams
- National Finalist, Flipkart WiRED 7.0 (2025)
- Campus Winner, ITC Interrobang Season 14 (2025)

POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY
- Coordinator, Consult Club, IIM Calcutta: ran 12 case-prep sessions for 140 first-years
- General Secretary, Commerce Society, SRCC (2023-24): led a 30-member team; raised INR 8 lakh in sponsorship for the annual fest

EXTRACURRICULAR
- State-level chess player (Delhi, U-19)
inputs.jd_text:
Summer Associate / Associate - Management Consulting
A leading global strategy consulting firm, India offices (Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru)

About the role
You will work in small teams with clients across consumer goods, financial services, industrials and technology to solve their most important strategic and operational problems.

Responsibilities
- Structure ambiguous business problems and develop hypotheses
- Gather and analyse data, including market sizing, customer interviews and financial models
- Synthesise insights and present recommendations to senior client stakeholders
- Work effectively in teams and contribute to a culture of collaboration

What we look for
- Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills
- Strong communication skills, written and verbal
- Demonstrated leadership in academic, extracurricular or professional settings
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity
- MBA from a top-tier business school

candidate.name: Kabir
candidate.current_or_last_role: PGP student, Indian Institute of Management Calcutta
candidate.band_reason: The resume shows strong ownership, selective quantified outcomes, prestigious results and clear evidence across consulting, leadership and competitions.

Gather and analyse data, including market sizing, customer interviews and financial models
Synthesise insights and present recommendations to senior client stakeholders

Demonstrated leadership in academic, extracurricular or professional settings
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity
MBA from a top-tier business school

claims.text: Market-entry assessment for a Japanese two-wheeler EV maker in India: sized the electric scooter market across 40 cities and built a city-prioritisation model on charging density and ownership cost
Interviewed 35 dealers and 12 fleet operators; findings shifted the client's launch city list from Delhi NCR first to Pune and Bengaluru first
Benchmarked 6 private banks' credit card rewards programs and recommended cutting 2 low-use reward categories
National Winner, HUL L.I.M.E. Season 16 (2026): rural distribution of a premium detergent; 1 of 3 winners from 21,000 teams
Coordinator, Consult Club, IIM Calcutta: ran 12 case-prep sessions for 140 first-years
General Secretary, Commerce Society, SRCC (2023-24): led a 30-member team; raised INR 8 lakh in sponsorship for the annual fest
claims.parent: Commerce Society, Shri Ram College of Commerce

plan.warmup_question: What is one thing you learned recently at IIM Calcutta that has already proved useful?
plan.background_question: Walk me through your path from SRCC to IIM Calcutta, including the experiences that led you toward consulting.

slots.core_question: At Bain, your research influenced the client's launch-city priorities. What did you do to turn those conversations into a recommendation?
slots.intent_private: Needs a specific account of Kabir's role in designing or conducting the interviews, interpreting the evidence, influencing the recommendation, and what he would do differently now.
likely_probes: Which interview insight most changed your view of the launch priorities?
What decision did you make when the dealer and fleet-operator evidence differed?
What was the baseline city list against which the shift was assessed?

slots.core_question: As General Secretary of the Commerce Society, what was the hardest leadership decision you made while working with the 30-member team?
slots.intent_private: Needs a concrete people-leadership situation, Kabir's decision and actions, stakeholder or team trade-offs, and the outcome of that decision.
likely_probes: Which team member or group needed the most support from you?
What did you decide when priorities within the team conflicted?
How did you judge whether the team delivered successfully?

slots.core_question: A consumer client enters a fragmented market with limited data. How would you structure the first phase of the problem?
slots.intent_private: Needs a clear issue tree or set of hypotheses, a practical prioritisation of analyses and data sources, and an explanation of how the approach would adapt as evidence emerges.
likely_probes: Why would you prioritise that line of inquiry over the alternatives?
When would your initial structure stop being useful?
What example from your own work shows how you structured an ambiguous problem?

slots.core_question: What draws you to this firm's management consulting role after your Bain summer internship?
slots.intent_private: Needs a reason tied to Kabir's own experience, a specific aspect of this firm's role or team from the available information or his research, and a clear reason for pursuing consulting now.
likely_probes: Which part of your summer experience most shaped this choice?
What specific aspect of this firm's work across sectors appeals to you?
How would this role add to what you already experienced at Bain?

plan.plan_notes: The plan prioritizes the relevant Bain internship, a substantive people-leadership experience, and a consulting problem-structuring knowledge question. Kabir has unusually strong quantified evidence and competition results, so the interview should test personal contribution and decision quality rather than broad resume coverage.
